Rune-stamped stone pillars rise from floor to vaulted ceiling, each face covered in tight rows of chiseled angular glyphs.
Veins of bright gold glint through the dark carved stone of the walls, catching the forge-light in glittering rivers.
Colossal iron-bound stone doors stand at the hall's end, their surfaces carved with deep interlocking rune-knots and clan seals.
Great black anvils and hammers stand along the forge floor, sparks scattered across the worn carved stone around them.
Piled treasure-hoards rise in corner alcoves, coins and gem-encrusted relics heaped against the stone walls in glittering mounds.
Brass and iron cog-machinery fills an entire wall, teeth meshing and turning in slow grinding arcs, driving unknown mechanisms.
Hanging braziers of black iron swing from thick chains bolted to the vaulted ceiling, casting orange light down in swaying pools.
A great stone throne dominates the hall's center, carved from a single block, its arms shaped into bearded dwarven kings.
Mine-cart rails of polished iron run across the floor in precise parallel lines, disappearing into dark tunnels cut in the rock.
Gem-studded archways frame each passage, rubies and sapphires pressed into carved stone borders glittering like constellations against the dark.
Beard-knot motifs are carved into every surface, the interlocking braid patterns repeating across columns, lintels, floors, and stone furniture alike.
Colossal chained gates of black iron hang suspended between two carved pillars, their links as thick as a dwarf's forearm.
Carved geometric friezes run the full length of every wall, each angular pattern locked into the next with absolute mathematical precision.
Deep forge-pits glow orange-red behind iron grates, heat shimmering upward in waves that warp the carved stone above them.
A great clan banner of hammered copper sheet hangs from iron rods, its surface etched with battle scenes and ancestor names.
Stone aqueduct channels cut into the floor carry dark water from deep springs toward the forge district in steady silent flows.
Shelves of catalogued ore samples line one carved alcove, each specimen labeled in tight dwarven script on small iron plaques.
Thick iron chains drape between pillars in heavy looping swags, their links polished to a dark gunmetal sheen by age.
A massive clock of interlocking brass gears is set into the wall, its face marked with dwarven numerals and deep runes.
Polished granite floors are inlaid with contrasting stone in angular mosaic patterns, each tile cut with obsessive geometric exactness.
Weapon racks of forged iron hold rows of axes and war-hammers, every blade edge gleaming sharp under the brazier-light.
Carved stone gutters along the walls channel forge-runoff and condensation in precise engineered paths toward distant drainage shafts below.
A deep-cut mural spans an entire wall face, showing dwarven armies marching from the mountain heart in geometric carved relief.
Iron lantern cages hang at intervals along every corridor, each cage stamped with small repeating rune-patterns across their black metal faces.
Stockpiles of dressed stone blocks sit on iron sledges near the walls, each block edge sharp and square to a mason's precision.
